title: GPHO Loop Feature Record
description: Day-1 frozen schema for static LLVM IR features, timings, and profitability labels.

suite.description: Benchmark suite tag for Leave-One-Benchmark-Out CV.

loop_id.description: Unique loop location key (func_name:line_num or IR loop name).

source_file.description: Optional path to originating source file.

gpu_safe.description: True iff DependenceAnalysis proves no loop-carried RAW/WAR/WAW blocking SIMT parallelization.

trip_count_eval.description: SCEV-evaluated constant trip count; 0 when unknown.

trip_count_unknown.description: True when SCEV cannot evaluate a constant trip count; forces conservative CPU stance.

arithmetic_intensity.description: (fp_op_count + int_op_count) / max(1, bytes_read + bytes_written) per iteration.

stride_one_accesses.description: Pointer accesses with SCEV step size of one element.

strided_accesses.description: Pointer accesses with step > 1 or non-affine.

divergence_score.description: Weighted ratio of conditional branches inside loop body.

transfer_bytes_est.description: Estimated host-device transfer footprint in bytes.

tti_cpu_cost.description: Optional sum of TargetTransformInfo CPU instruction costs per iteration.

tti_gpu_cost.description: Optional sum of TargetTransformInfo GPU-oriented instruction costs per iteration.

t_cpu_ms.description: Measured host CPU median execution time (ms). Null until profiled.

t_gpu_ms.description: Measured total GPU offload median time including transfers (ms). Null until profiled.

label_profitable.description: True iff speedup_actual >= 1.20. Null until labeled.
